summary: Ansible 9.12.0 deprecated the unmaintained community.network collection and announced the google.cloud collection will be removed from Ansible 12 because of unresolved sanity test failures.
questions: Will google.cloud still ship in Ansible 12?
How can I keep using google.cloud if it's removed from the package?

answer_card.title: community.network and google.cloud removal notices
answer_card.answer_md:
- **community.network** is deprecated and will be removed from **Ansible 12** unless someone takes over maintenance.
- **google.cloud** will be removed from **Ansible 12** due to unresolved sanity test failures (removal can be cancelled if fixed).

You can still install either one yourself with `ansible-galaxy collection install <name>`.
